description:
You are an HR analytics manager preparing a workforce quality report for the executive team. Using `employee_performance.csv` at `C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\PowerBITasks\employee_performance.csv` (columns: ID, Name, Age, Gender, Department, Salary, Joining Date, Performance Score, Experience, Status, Location, Session), build an HR analytics report in Power BI Desktop.

The data has a data quality problem: some rows have a blank `Performance Score`. You must fix this in Power Query before building the report.

The finished report `HR_Workforce_Analytics.pbix` must be saved on the Desktop and satisfy all of the following:

1. In Power Query Editor, add a step that removes (filters out) all rows where `Performance Score` is null or blank, so only employees with a recorded score remain.
2. Add a conditional column named `Performance_Tier` in Power Query using the following rules:
   - 'High' if Performance Score > 3
   - 'Mid' if Performance Score >= 2 and <= 3
   - 'Low' if Performance Score < 2
3. Name the single report page exactly 'Workforce Analysis'.
4. On that page, create three visuals:
   a. A Stacked Bar Chart showing employee count by Department, with Performance_Tier as the color legend
   b. A Line Chart showing average Salary by Experience (years on X-axis, average Salary on Y-axis)
   c. A Slicer for the Status column (to filter Active vs. Inactive employees)
5. Save the report as `HR_Workforce_Analytics.pbix` on the Desktop (`C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\`).

Login: user is `Docker`, no password required.
